metadata.title: The Edge of AI Research: David with Gangdisi's Chief FDE

conclusion: David sits with Gangdisi FDE Laobai. Shop in 2019, AI terminal June 2023, briefs that year, client reports in 2024–25, and a 2026 self-train loop he calls a near-100% deliverable. FDEs are finance people — Palantir coined the title; OpenAI/Anthropic hire for the business. A K3-class model at 2.8 trillion parameters still leaves 3,000 function points, about 30 in use. H200 cost on the tape: 1.5 million to 5.5 million. The buy button stays human. They staff the eager 20% of a 20/60/20 shop.
background: Fireside-style 投资实战派 E199, taped Aug 28, published Sept 13. Whisper-small on Xiaoyuzhou audio (names come through as 钢地斯/使账派). David has been deep on AI research for 3–4 months and wanted someone who both uses it and staffs clients. Palantir's FDE boast is the opening joke.
important_facts: Clock: Gangdisi 2019 after Laobai's fuzzy-algorithm youth and a dead job market. Three years of data, then June 2023 — months after OpenAI's consumer break — they ship their own AI research terminal. 2023: AI writes briefs. 2024–25: industry notes, stock work, investment memos for clients. 2026: self-training and what he calls a basically 100% result handed to the user. A K3-class model at 2.8 trillion parameters is the named upgrade. H200 on his cost tape: 1.5 million two years ago, 5.5 million now (treat as their marker, not a street print).

FDE: Palantir trademarked the glow. Laobai says OpenAI and Anthropic job specs ignore coding and demand domain. His team has zero engineers — they drive FanBot-class agents and know what a 3G filing and a sector word mean. Taobao hired shoe people as xiao'er; he hires PMs. Product sprawl: ~3,000 function points, about 30 in daily use; April talk of 40 skills versus a later 14–20-skill working set; 20 agents and 19 MCP hooks on one pass. More surface area is not more research.

Style and the 20%: value, growth, and trend shops train the same agent differently — data diet, prompts, files. One client never lets AI pick a stock; he only watches upstream prints that move prices in days. Judgment — buy or pass — is the part AI cannot retire. User split on the tape: 20% want to live in it, 60% watch, 20% refuse. They staff the first 20. A >¥10 billion universe of ~1,800 names is the named pond. When 'everyone' is at 80% capability, the edge moves. 24% gross-margin jumps and a 20-day couch holiday are color, not a model.

mental_model.name: Domain FDE × Small Skill Surface × Human Buy Button
mental_model.components: Hire finance people who can hear the client, then let an agent write the board. Keep 30 of 3,000 features. 2019 data plus a June 2023 terminal plus a 2026 self-train loop is the clock. K3 at 2.8T and a rising H200 bill are the infra prints. Style lives in the data diet, not in a bigger report pile. The 20/60/20 shop only pays for the first 20%. The buy button stays with the PM. The 20/60/20 split is why a 100% delivery line still sits on a niche attach.
mental_model.application: Gangdisi is a private research terminal — diligence the 20% attach, not the 100% delivery line. OpenAI is the 2023 trigger and the FDE job-spec compare. NVDA is the H200 cost marker. PLTR is the FDE brand they refuse to copy as a sales glow. Do not underwrite 'AI picks the stock.'

key_insights.view: FDE is a PM, not a compiler.
key_insights.question: Why no engineers?
key_insights.answer: OpenAI/Anthropic hire for the business. His team is finance plus FanBot. Taobao's shoe xiao'er is the metaphor.

key_insights.question: What is the product lesson?
key_insights.answer: April 40-skill talk versus a 14–20 working set. 20 agents and 19 MCP hooks do not make a better memo.

key_insights.question: Where does the loop stop?
key_insights.answer: Data and training can be styled. Judgment cannot. They only staff the eager 20%.

top_investment_implications.thesis: 2019 shop, 2023 terminal, 2026 self-train — a 20% attach story, not a 100% delivery multiple — low
H200 cost on the tape 1.5M to 5.5M is their infra marker — low
FDE brand they refuse: Palantir glow versus finance people plus an agent — low
